title: Arkret Accountability Grant
description: Issuer-signed endorsement used to verify Actor Profile accountable_principal_ids entries. This is the payload contract for ak.identity.accountability_grant.

issuer_id.description: Stable principal did_core_id accepting accountability for subject. Verifiers MUST take the proof verification-method DID URL's bare controller did, validate it with the registered method adapter, and require project(did) to equal issuer; direct DID/core-id string comparison is forbidden.

accountability_scope.description: Non-empty duplicate-free closed set used only for display and accountability governance; never grants authorization. A string is the singleton-set wire form. Array order has no semantic meaning. Canonical authors emit singleton sets as strings and multi-value sets in ascending raw UTF-8 byte order; receivers accept every schema-valid ordering and normalize only for cell-subject derivation, domain equality, and projection union.

expires_at.description: Optional: absent means the accountability grant is non-expiring and governed by grant_status revocation and controller lifecycle cascade.

proof.description: Detached proof by issuer over utf8('ak.accountability-grant-v1\n') || canonical_json(the object with proof omitted).
